requirements.summary: The tests are built from the pinned commits, unchanged, with recorded tool versions.
Each of the 40 tests is preprocessed, assembled and linked without an unhandled relocation.
The repository's ISS runs each image to tohost = 1, in both of its modes.
The core runs each image to tohost = 1 in three configurations and retires the same instructions as the ISS.
The reason for not using the upstream environment still holds.
A wrong data word, a wrong relocation and mutations of the core are noticed as pinned.
